tool_schemas.name: create-time-entry
tool_schemas.description: Creates a time entry owned by the given Clockify-linked user in the specified workspace, optionally associated to a project, and returns the created time entry record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when start_time/end_time are not RFC3339 timestamps, or when end_time is not after start_time; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace_id, user_id, or (if provided) project_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the user is not allowed to create entries in the workspace or the project is not in that workspace. Raises CONFLICT when the requested user/workspace relationship is not valid for creation (e.g., user is not a member of the workspace) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the integration’s write limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID where the time entry will be created.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entry.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to associate to the time entry.

start_time.description: Start time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

end_time.description: End time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: get-projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in a workspace (id and name) so they can be selected for time entries, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is not a valid Clockify workspace ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to view that workspace’s projects and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-current-user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the currently authenticated Clockify-linked user (at minimum id and name) for use in subsequent workspace and time-entry operations. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid authentication is available and FORBIDDEN when the authenticated identity is not permitted to access Clockify-linked resources. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces accessible to the specified Clockify-linked user (id and name), returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when user_id is not a valid Clockify user ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the user does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to list workspaces for that user and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID to list accessible workspaces for.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-time-entries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries for a workspace owned by the specified Clockify-linked user, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Supports filtering by status, time range, and optional project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when date-time filters are invalid, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN when the user does not have an active membership in the workspace; raises NOT_FOUND when referenced resources do not exist.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list time entries for.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entries.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to filter time entries by.

from_time.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

to_time.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-time-entry
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single time entry by ULID and returns the full time entry record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is not a valid time entry ULID; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the workspace/user that owns the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: update-time-entry
tool_schemas.description: Updates writable fields on a time entry and returns the updated record. Supports valid lifecycle transitions for time_entries.status: pending -> created/failed/cancelled; failed -> pending/cancelled. A transition to pending re-queues the integration to attempt upstream creation again; cancelled prevents further attempts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when start_time/end_time are not RFC3339 timestamps, when end_time is before start_time, when project_id does not belong to workspace_id, or when an invalid status transition is requested; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to mutate the time entry; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry (or referenced project) does not exist.

start_time.description: Updated start time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Required if end_time is provided.

end_time.description: Updated end time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Use null to represent a running entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

project_id.description: Project ULID to associate, or null to clear the project.

status.description: New status for the time entry; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tool_schemas.name: sync-clockify
tool_schemas.description: Synchronizes the active Clockify-linked user, their accessible workspaces, memberships, and projects from Clockify into the local store and returns a summary of what was updated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid authentication is available, FORBIDDEN when the identity is not permitted to access Clockify-linked resources, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when sync/read limits are exceeded.

include_projects.description: Whether to sync projects for accessible workspaces (defaults to true).

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace ULID to limit the sync scope to a single workspace.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def sync_clockify(include_projects=None, workspace_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, random

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0394000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0394000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    now = now_dt.isoformat()

    usage = _load("usage_logs.json")
    if not isinstance(usage, list):
        usage = []

    # defaults
    if include_projects is None:
        include_projects = True
    if include_projects is not None and not isinstance(include_projects, bool):
        usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": None, "status": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
        _save("usage_logs.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "include_projects must be boolean.")

    ulid_re = r"[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}"
    if workspace_id is not None:
        if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(rf"^clk_wsp_{ulid_re}$", workspace_id):
            usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": None, "status": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
            _save("usage_logs.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "workspace_id is not a valid workspace ULID.")

    # quota: 50 sync/day per context; rate: 10/min
    def _count(window_s):
        cutoff = time.time() - window_s
        c = 0
        for r in usage:
            if r.get("endpoint") == "sync-clockify":
                ts = r.get("ts_unix")
                if isinstance(ts, (int, float)) and ts >= cutoff and r.get("status") == "OK":
                    c += 1
        return c

    if _count(60) >= 10:
        usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": None, "status": "RATE_LIMIT", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
        _save("usage_logs.json", usage)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Sync rate limit exceeded. Please retry later.")
    if _count(86400) >= 50:
        usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": None, "status": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
        _save("usage_logs.json", usage)
        return _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Daily sync quota exceeded.")

    users = _load("clockify_users.json")
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    memberships = _load("workspace_memberships.json")
    projects = _load("projects.json")

    # Ambient auth: must have an active user OR be able to "create/sync it from Clockify".
    # Offline store: if none exists, create a minimal active user.
    created_user = False
    active_user = next((u for u in users if u.get("status") == "active"), None)

    def _gen_ulid_like(prefix):
        # not a true ULID; matches required regex charset/length
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        rnd = "".join(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(26))
        return f"{prefix}_{rnd}"

    if active_user is None:
        # create new active user row (sync stub)
        new_id = _gen_ulid_like("clk_usr")
        # enforce unique(clockify_user_id): generate
        clockify_user_id = "cfy_" + _gen_ulid_like("u").replace("u_", "")
        row = {
            "id": new_id,
            "clockify_user_id": clockify_user_id,
            "display_name": "Clockify User",
            "email": None,
            "timezone": "UTC",
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
            "last_synced_at": now
        }
        users.append(row)
        _save("clockify_users.json", users)
        active_user = row
        created_user = True
    else:
        # update last_synced_at
        active_user["last_synced_at"] = now
        active_user["updated_at"] = now
        # write-through (update in list)
        for i, u in enumerate(users):
            if u.get("id") == active_user.get("id"):
                users[i] = active_user
                break
        _save("clockify_users.json", users)

    # Determine accessible active workspaces: those with active membership for this user.
    # If none exist, create one workspace and membership as part of sync.
    user_id_val = active_user.get("id")
    accessible_ws_ids = {m.get("workspace_id") for m in memberships if m.get("user_id") == user_id_val and m.get("status") == "active"}

    created_ws = 0
    created_m = 0
    updated_ws = 0
    updated_m = 0
    created_prj = 0
    updated_prj = 0

    def _find_ws(ws_id):
        return next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == ws_id), None)

    if not accessible_ws_ids:
        # create at least one active workspace + membership
        ws_id = _gen_ulid_like("clk_wsp")
        # enforce unique(clockify_workspace_id)
        cfy_wid = "cfy_" + _gen_ulid_like("w").replace("w_", "")
        ws_row = {
            "id": ws_id,
            "clockify_workspace_id": cfy_wid,
            "name": "Default Workspace",
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
            "last_synced_at": now
        }
        workspaces.append(ws_row)
        created_ws += 1

        mem_id = _gen_ulid_like("clk_mem")
        mem_row = {
            "id": mem_id,
            "user_id": user_id_val,
            "workspace_id": ws_id,
            "role": "member",
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        memberships.append(mem_row)
        created_m += 1

        _save("workspaces.json", workspaces)
        _save("workspace_memberships.json", memberships)

        accessible_ws_ids = {ws_id}

    # Apply workspace_id scope limit if provided
    if workspace_id is not None:
        if workspace_id not in accessible_ws_ids:
            # identity not permitted to access this workspace (tool says FORBIDDEN, but contract doesn't)
            usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": user_id_val, "status": "UNAUTHORIZED", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
            _save("usage_logs.json", usage)
            return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Not permitted to sync the specified workspace.")
        accessible_ws_ids = {workspace_id}

    # "Sync" workspaces and memberships: refresh updated_at/last_synced_at
    for ws_id in list(accessible_ws_ids):
        ws = _find_ws(ws_id)
        if ws is None:
            # broken FK; create workspace stub
            ws_row = {
                "id": ws_id,
                "clockify_workspace_id": "cfy_" + _gen_ulid_like("w").replace("w_", ""),
                "name": "Recovered Workspace",
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
                "last_synced_at": now
            }
            workspaces.append(ws_row)
            created_ws += 1
        else:
            ws["last_synced_at"] = now
            ws["updated_at"] = now
            updated_ws += 1

    # ensure membership row exists and is active for scoped workspaces
    for ws_id in list(accessible_ws_ids):
        mem = next((m for m in memberships if m.get("user_id") == user_id_val and m.get("workspace_id") == ws_id), None)
        if mem is None:
            mem_row = {
                "id": _gen_ulid_like("clk_mem"),
                "user_id": user_id_val,
                "workspace_id": ws_id,
                "role": "member",
                "status": "active",
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            }
            memberships.append(mem_row)
            created_m += 1
        else:
            if mem.get("status") != "active":
                # valid transition inactive->active
                mem["status"] = "active"
            mem["updated_at"] = now
            updated_m += 1

    _save("workspaces.json", workspaces)
    _save("workspace_memberships.json", memberships)

    # projects sync: for each accessible workspace, ensure at least one active project (unless include_projects false)
    if include_projects:
        for ws_id in list(accessible_ws_ids):
            ws_projects = [p for p in projects if p.get("workspace_id") == ws_id]
            if not ws_projects:
                prj = {
                    "id": _gen_ulid_like("clk_prj"),
                    "workspace_id": ws_id,
                    "clockify_project_id": "cfy_" + _gen_ulid_like("p").replace("p_", ""),
                    "name": "General",
                    "color": None,
                    "billable_default": False,
                    "status": "active",
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                    "last_synced_at": now
                }
                projects.append(prj)
                created_prj += 1
            else:
                for p in ws_projects:
                    p["last_synced_at"] = now
                    p["updated_at"] = now
                    # keep status as-is (active/archived); only count active ones as updated
                    updated_prj += 1
        _save("projects.json", projects)

    summary = {
        "active_user_id": user_id_val,
        "scoped_workspace_ids": sorted(accessible_ws_ids),
        "created": {
            "user": 1 if created_user else 0,
            "workspaces": created_ws,
            "memberships": created_m,
            "projects": created_prj if include_projects else 0
        },
        "updated": {
            "workspaces": updated_ws,
            "memberships": updated_m,
            "projects": updated_prj if include_projects else 0
        },
        "include_projects": include_projects,
        "synced_at": now
    }

    usage.append({"endpoint": "sync-clockify", "key": user_id_val, "status": "OK", "ts": now, "ts_unix": time.time(), "latency_ms": int((time.time()-t0)*1000)})
    _save("usage_logs.json", usage)

    return {"data": summary}

metadata.name: Clockify Time Entry Manager
metadata.description: This backend stores Clockify-linked identities (current user), the workspaces they can access, projects inside those workspaces, and time entries created by the integration. Primary workflows are: discover current user, list accessible workspaces, list projects for a workspace, and create a time ent
